jobs.occupation: Danish speaking Customer Service Representative for SAS!
jobs.description:
Concentrix is a global company specializing in technology and services, supporting the brands of the future in more than 70 countries. With some of the world’s largest and most well-known brands in our client portfolio, there is a high chance that you have already interacted with one of our 440,000 Concentrix employees. Our game-changers deliver world-class customer service for our clients’ customers, helping businesses grow and build strong relationships.
If you want to be inspired and grow in your career, we encourage you to apply for the role of Travel Agent for our brand-new client SAS and become part of our global network of employees. You will be part of the team creating outstanding customer service experiences for SAS’ private customers. In this role, you will work from our office in Helsingborg, Sweden.
About the Role
Your daily work will involve providing world-class support via phone and chat to SAS’ Danish private customers. This may include inquiries regarding flight reservations, payments, refunds, and online services, to mention just a few. You will also be responsible for providing information about flight schedules, available destinations, and special requirements (wheelchair passengers, traveling with pets, etc.). In addition, you will be an expert in planning and proposing smart solutions for customers in difficult situations such as canceled flights, delays, or schedule changes.
To Thrive in This Role
We are looking for someone who is an excellent listener, proactive, and always strives to create an outstanding customer experience. You are naturally positive and energetic and balance professionalism with personality and engagement. You are good at expressing and explaining yourself both verbally and in writing. You enjoy working independently and are flexible when it comes to changes in your work. Stress tolerance is an important quality to succeed in this role.
You speak and write Danish fluently (C1) and English (B2).
You can work within the opening hours Monday–Friday 07:00–19:15 and weekends 09:00–18:15.
You can work from our office in Helsingborg.
You are at least 18 years old.
You have good computer skills.
6 months of customer contact experience.

What We Offer
We will ensure you have the best opportunities to succeed in this role by offering a 7-week training program combining practical training and hands-on experience. You will work with modern equipment and support staff who will help you develop into an excellent customer representative. In addition, you will receive regular feedback to support your development. At Concentrix, there is always a career path for those who want it—nearly 80% of our team leaders have been promoted internally.
A total of 7 weeks of training.
The opportunity to start something completely new together with dedicated colleagues.
25 paid vacation days per year as well as other benefits.
Internal career programs.

Job Details
Start date: 2027-01-04
Employment type: Full-time with a 6-month probation period
Working hours: Monday–Friday 07:00–19:15 and weekends 09:00–18:15 (your shifts will be scheduled within these hours, 40 hours/week)
Location: Concentrix office in Helsingborg, Rönnowsgatan 8c
Has this caught your interest? Don’t hesitate to send us your application right away!

The Opportunity
We, Hitachi Energy – Insulation and Components, are looking for you who would like to join us in the position Sales Engineer Tap-changers!
We are working within the transformer business, supplying world-class components to transformer manufacturers worldwide. We are proud of our product portfolio, our global customer base as well as our modern production units. Our strong ambition will always be to be our customers’ preferred choice of supply and hope that you will play a key role.
Are you a person with excellent technical knowledge in Tap changers combined with a commercial drive and a true interest in working close to customers and colleagues? Do you enjoy using your knowledge to educate and train others, colleagues and customers alike, to work closely together with customers to ensure our products are matched with their needs? Then this could be the right opportunity for you!
As a Sales Engineer Tap-changers, you are an important part of the circuit of knowledge within and outside Hitachi Energy. You support the factory/regional teams in sales and marketing activities and regularly train our sales and tender team on the existing portfolio of products.
This position is based in Ludvika, Sweden.
How you’ll make an impact
Apply Tap-changer application knowledge to work closely with customers/marketing/sales/tender to ensure our solution matches customer needs.
Active participation in events related to Tap-changers
Identify portfolio gaps and feed R&D with market technology demand.
Develop strong product market material including product presentations and leading seminaries in demonstrating/presenting Tap-changers.
Update our quotation tool with pre-defined customer solutions.
Ensure colleagues are continuously informed about product life-cycle status, including product introductions, updates, phase-outs, and replacement strategies.
Support the Risk Review process by providing technical input and identifying relevant technical risk triggers.

Your background
A minimum of three years’ engineering experience in Tap changer technology.
An easy-going doer with demonstrable leadership skills. 
Communicative and can explain advanced technical knowledge in a simple and easy way.
Strategic with a constant business mind.
Fluency in English, written and spoken is mandatory, preferably and with advantage multilingual (for example Swedish, Spanish, German, French).
International travel required (approx. 30%)

What we offer 
Collective agreement
Flexible working time
Health care and wellness allowance
Fantastic career possibilities within Hitachi Energy both within Sweden and globally
Mentor to support you throughout onboard phase
Various trainings and education supporting employee development​
Diversified company with over 70+ nationalities working in Sweden
Supplementary compensation for parental leave

The opportunity
The transition to sustainable energy is accelerating, and HVDC technology plays a vital role in connecting large-scale offshore wind generation to power grids worldwide. To support the growing demand for offshore HVDC solutions, we have established a dedicated engineering organization focused on Automation and Control systems, including Protection & Control, SCADA, HMI, IT/OT Infrastructure, Cyber Security, Telecommunications, and Electrical Design.
We are looking for an experienced Electrical Design Engineer to join our team and contribute to the delivery of some of the world's most advanced HVDC projects. In this role, you will collaborate with internal teams and external partners to develop and integrate electrical solutions across the project lifecycle, from tendering and design through installation and commissioning support.
How you´ll make an impact​
Develop and maintain electrical design documentation, including cable block diagrams, cable schedules, circuit diagrams, and related engineering documentation.
Support the integration of supplier-delivered systems into the overall HVDC solution.
Review, specify, and approve electrical design deliverables from suppliers and engineering partners.
Coordinate technical interfaces between suppliers and cross-functional project teams.
Contribute technical expertise during tendering, design, and project execution phases.
Support installation, testing, and commissioning activities, both remotely and at project sites when required.
Identify and resolve technical issues to ensure safe, high-quality, and efficient project delivery.

Your Background
A degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent technical education.
At least 5 years of experience in electrical design within power systems, substations, HVDC, industrial automation, or related fields.
Documented experience using E3. Series CAD for electrical design and documentation.
Knowledge of additional electrical design tools such as Engineering Base, AutoCAD Electrical, or similar software.
Experience with secondary systems design in substations, power transmission, or comparable industries.
A solid understanding of electrical equipment, low-voltage control systems, and automation applications.
Great communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in diverse, international project environments and communicate fluently in English.

The opportunity
Join our Grid Quality team as a Power System Simulation Model Engineer and help shape the future of sustainable energy. Work on cutting-edge solutions that strengthen grids, enable renewable integration, and accelerate the energy transition—perfect for fresh graduates in Electrical, Power, or Energy Engineering.
How you’ll make an impact
Develop, implement, validate, and deliver simulation models to our customers in tenders and projects using various power system tools to support grid optimization and renewable integration
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including our R&D, and customers, to gather requirements to support the design of effective technical solutions.
Create software in the loop model of real-time control functions
Perform testing and validation of power system models and associated tools.
Perform RMS simulation studies with customer networks
Prepare clear and structured technical documentation and reports.
Stay updated on industry trends, tools, and best practices in power system modeling.
Contribute to knowledge sharing by supporting, training, and collaborating with colleagues throughout project execution.

Your Background
M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering or a related field, with at least three years of experience in power system analysis.
Knowledge of, or experience with, power system simulation tools such as RTDS, PSCAD, PSS®E, DIgSILENT PowerFactory, MATLAB and EMTP.
Interest in or experience with programming (e.g., C++, C#, FORTRAN, DSL, Python, MATLAB), control theory, signal processing, and dynamic modelling.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to work independently, take initiative, and solve complex problems.
Proficiency in English is required; knowledge of Swedish is considered an advantage.

Drive Strategy. Lead Growth. Make an Impact.
Instabee is changing the way last-mile deliveries work in Europe. We make online shopping faster, smarter, and more convenient. In Finland, we’ve scaled quickly—but we’re just getting started. Now, we need a strategic powerhouse to help shape our expansion, drive high-impact projects, and turn opportunities into growth.
If you’re an analytical problem solver who thrives on tackling complex business challenges, working cross-functionally, and translating strategy into execution, let’s talk.
What You’ll Do 📈 Shape the Strategy – Assess market opportunities, identify challenges, and help define the roadmap for Instabee Finland’s growth.
🔍 Lead High-Impact Projects – Take ownership of complex, cross-functional initiatives that drive business performance and scale our operations.
🤝 Work with Leadership – Collaborate closely with the Country Manager and senior team to set targets and implement strategic plans.
📊 Use Data to Drive Decisions – Monitor performance, track key business metrics, and adjust strategies based on insights.
⚡ Remove Roadblocks – Identify challenges, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure our strategic initiatives run smoothly.
🚀 Think Big, Plan for the Future – We’re looking for someone with the ambition and potential to grow into a larger leadership role over time.
Who You Are
✅ A Strategic Thinker with a Commercial Edge – You have experience in strategy, management consulting, investment banking, or business development. Start-up/scale-up experience is a bonus.
✅ A Problem-Solver Who Gets Things Done – You thrive in ambiguity, take ownership, and know how to move projects forward.
✅ A Data-Driven Decision Maker – You use insights, analytics, and performance tracking to sharpen your approach and drive measurable impact.
✅ An Effective Communicator – You can turn complex ideas into clear, actionable plans and collaborate across teams.
✅ Experience Matters Most, but Education Helps – you have probably Master’s degree in business, economics, engineering, or a related field
✅ Fluent in English (Finnish is a bonus) – You can communicate clearly and persuasively in a fast-moving, international environment.
Why Instabee?
🌍 Join a Fast-Growing Company – Be part of a team that’s reshaping e-commerce logistics in Europe.
🚀 Advance Your Career – This role is built for growth, with a path toward broader leadership.
🏢 Work Flexibly – Hybrid setup with a modern Helsinki office centrally located in Kluuvi.
💡 Work with Cutting-Edge Tech – Shape the future of logistics with smart, data-driven solutions.
🎉 A Culture That Values Action – We move fast, make decisions quickly, and focus on what works.
Ready to Make an Impact? We’re looking for someone who’s ready to own projects, drive strategy, and shape the future of Instabee in Finland. If that’s you, apply today.
About Instabee
Instabee was founded in 2022 after combining Budbee and Instabox — two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox and Porterbuddy. Instabee is present in six countries, serving thousands of online merchants, including ASOS, Zalando, Inditex and H&M and is on track to become the most admired European e-commerce enabler.
In Finland, Budbee has been a key player since 2018 — and we’re moving fast.

We are also seeing AI becoming an increasingly important part of software development and our clients' technical environments. Therefore, we are particularly interested in developers who have experience working with AI technologies or who have used AI as part of their development work.

🎯 The Ideal Candidate
We’re looking for an experienced Software Engineer who enjoys solving technical problems and working in different environments. As a consultant, you are comfortable collaborating with different teams and stakeholders and adapting to different technical contexts and client needs.
You are also curious about developments within AI and have an interest in how AI can be used in software development and technical solutions.
👉 Requirements

University degree within the IT field.

Minimum of 5+ years of experience in software development using languages such as Java, Python, Ruby, Go, C#, or Node.js.

Experience in API development and database management (SQL and NoSQL).

Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.

Experience working with security and authentication, such as OAuth.

Experience or practical knowledge of AI technologies and tools.

Strong communication skills in both Swedish and English.

Willingness to work on-site with clients in Skåne and occasionally travel within the region.

🌈 Bonus Points

Experience integrating AI services or LLMs into applications.

Experience with technologies or concepts such as RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or AI agents.

Experience with machine learning models.

Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines.

Experience with microservice or serverless architecture.

Knowledge of messaging systems such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.

🌍 Why ICT Additude?
At ICT Additude, you’ll be part of an experienced team of consultants working within software and technology. We value knowledge-sharing and offer continuous development through regular dev-talks with your manager.
Your employment is covered by a collective agreement and includes benefits such as 30 days of holiday, ITP1 pension, a 5,000 SEK wellness allowance, and the option of a benefit bike or car.
Based in Malmö/Lund, we are part of ICT Group, a European technology group working within software, technology, and product development.
Please note that we are looking for colleagues already located in Sweden, and we will only consider applications submitted through our ATS.

Support production scale-up and operational excellence.

Coordinate validation, qualification and production readiness activities.

Define requirements for MES and production systems.

Production & Operations

Responsibilities

jobs.occupation: Internship – Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), Energy Transfer &
jobs.description:
Company Description

Vattenfall is a leading European energy company with 12 million customers and approximately 21,000 employees. We are convinced that there is a way to build a future in which everyone can choose fossil-free ways to transport, produce, and live.

Job Description

Are you a student looking to apply your knowledge to real-world solutions that support the energy transition? With us, you'll have the opportunity to complete your internship close to the business, working alongside experienced specialists and tackling challenges where your ideas and perspectives can make a real difference.
About the internship
As an intern, you will join the Energy Transfer & Environment group within Vattenfall R&D Laboratories, working alongside specialists in fluid mechanics and Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD). Our work includes numerical flow modelling and experimental measurements for energy applications, including hydropower and nuclear power.
During the internship, you will work with CFD on a defined fluid-mechanics problem relevant to the group’s ongoing activities. Proposed tasks include preparing simulation models and computational meshes, setting up and running simulations, evaluating flow behaviour, and comparing results with available experimental data or reference cases, where applicable. The specific application and simulation tools will be agreed with the supervisor.
The aim of the internship is to develop practical skills in CFD and contribute to the understanding of an energy-related flow problem. You will document modelling assumptions, assess the quality and limitations of the results, and present your findings in a technical report and a final presentation to the group.
Duration: Five months, full-time.This internship is for two students. 

Qualifications

We are looking for students who are currently enrolled in ongoing studies and are eager to put their knowledge into practice through an internship at Vattenfall. You are also someone who identifies with our principles: Active, Open, Positive, and Safety. In addition, we expect you to meet the following requirements:
Education: Ongoing university studies in Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Energy Engineering or a related discipline, preferably with coursework in fluid mechanics, numerical methods and CFD.
Previous experience with a CFD solver and programming or data analysis is an advantage.
Language skills: Good command of English, both spoken and written, for technical discussions, documentation and presentations.
Availability: Able to undertake a five-month internship as part of your ongoing studies.

Additional Information
Start of assignment: By agreement.
Location: Solna. 
Application – a document with your CV.
Application deadline: 2026-11-30.
Contact person and proposed supervisor at Vattenfall: Eric Lillberg, Senior Principal R&D Engineer, Fluid Mechanics/CFD, eric.lillberg@vattenfall.com, +46 70 537 29 94.

Diversity and Inclusion – In Everything We Do
At Vattenfall, we value being Active, Positive, Open, and Safety-conscious. We are looking for employees who share our vision and can contribute to strengthening our company culture. We believe that diversity helps build a more successful and attractive company, and we strive to be role models in diversity and inclusion. Vattenfall actively works to ensure that all employees have equal opportunities and rights, regardless of age, ethnic or cultural background, gender identity, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or disability. Read more about how we work with diversity and inclusion here.
Vattenfall is part of Sweden’s critical infrastructure, and therefore many of our positions are security-classified. If this position is security-classified, a security screening will be conducted prior to employment in accordance with the Swedish Security Protection Act.

We are looking to expand our EATS´ team with a Calibration Engineer to work within Engine Controls & Diagnostics.
Job description:
You will work in a team responsible for securing that the engine fulfils the emission legislation, by developing and calibrating its own inhouse software models. The team consists of calibration engineers and function developers. You & the team will calibrate start and catalyst heating, emission control and purge control. The team delivers engine software to combustion engines in both mild hybrid and hybrid applications. 
From an early stage you will be involved in the development of new powertrain concepts and its software, where the team has the responsibility for vehicle emissions, and develop solutions that meet both legal requirements and give the customer an outstanding product. 
Early in the projects you will  be collecting data from the engine test rigs, in order to calibrate the software-models. Validation and later, final verification are always performed in cars or what the application is suited for. The job variety is huge and the need for further development is always there, which provides an interesting research atmosphere.
What you will do:
You will work in a team with experienced engineers but have a clear area of responsibility. Your main tasks will be to calibrate emission-related functions. 
The team is doing a large amount of our work in different engine test cells located in the laboratory, but also in vehicles on site and during expeditions to find extreme climates and altitudes. You will use advanced programs for modelling and data processing for best results.
﻿Main tasks:
Plan and develop methods of the calibration process.
Define and handle requirements within the system and from other areas.
Deliver calibration and verification of emission related functions.
Verify calibration in rigs and cars in different environments.
Evaluation and problem analysis.

 
Is this you?
To enjoy and succeed in the role, we see that you have a great interest in the latest technology, and you have an interest in powertrain controls and calibration. You also like to dig into a huge amount of data. You are a positive and self-driven person, who strives to see "the big picture" to be able to contribute in the best way. You appreciate being a part of a team and are a good communicator. Further, you are always curious, and love to solve problems in a pragmatic way!
 Skill requirements
Qualifications:
•	We believe you have a Bachelor’s or Master’s in the field of Mechanical, Physics, or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent You have a passion for cars and internal combustion engines.
•	Fluent in Matlab/Python/Simulink
•	Fluent in English (written and spoken)
•	Driver’s license (Swedish B-level, passenger car)
•	Fluent in Swedish (written and spoken) is a plus
•	Good knowledge of internal combustion engines
•	Passion for vehicles and powertrains
•	Theoretical courses in combustion engines, software programming and electronics
•	Experience in ETAS INCA software
﻿Personal qualities
•	Self-driven with a positive attitude
•	Strong analytical skills as well as being able to execute tests “hands-on”
•	You plan, conduct, summarize and report your work in a structured and thorough manner
•	A curious and problemsolving mindset
• You can easily communicate and collaborate
• A true teamplayer open and supportive
This is a fantastic opportunity to contribute to advanced engine development while being part of a collaborative and supportive team.
You need to be living in Sweden and be able to work 100% onsite in Gothenburg.
Looking forward to meeting you!
